mechanism: Ginseng may potentiate serotonergic effects of rizatriptan, a 5-HT1B/1D agonist, increasing risk of serotonin syndrome; additionally, ginseng has mild antiplatelet properties that could theoretically increase bleeding risk.
action: Monitor patients for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, tremor, hyperthermia); counsel on bleeding precautions; consider alternative herbal supplements with lower serotonergic activity.
